thread:
Amit Rao: Heads-up — planning a short sprint next week to scope 'log provenance & crypto-ops' for enterprise customers. Main asks: tenant-scoped key policies, legal-hold snapshots, immutable log provenance (signed manifests), and SOC2 evidence IDs. Need to decide MVP and launch gates by EOD Friday.
Maya Lin: +1. Can we separate two tracks: (1) crypto handshake / BYOK onboarding, (2) provenance & retention controls? Different teams own each.
Chris Park: I like two tracks. For (1) we need KMS provider adapters + key rotation handshake spec. For (2) we need a signed manifest format and an index for fast evidence lookup.
Samir Patel: FYI FinRegCorp asked for a proof-of-rotation artifact: signed SHA256 chain for each rotation event. They want it attachable to audit packages.
Jordan (Security): For SOC2/ISO we need acceptable retention buckets and tamper-evidence for logs. Suggest acceptance criteria: signed manifest per-week, per-tenant retention policy UI, auditable export with signature.
Maya Lin: Proposed MVP (minimal):
- BYOK onboarding flow (upload wrapped key OR KMS ARN)
- Tenant-level retention toggle + default buckets (30/90/365)
- Weekly signed manifest generation stored for 90 days
- Legal-hold flag on tenant snapshots (manual export)
That should satisfy most early customers.
Amit Rao: Tradeoffs: signed manifests every request would be expensive. Weekly batch sounds right. We should design API so customers can request an on-demand snapshot with signature for legal hold.
Chris Park: Technical notes for eng-runtime: we need a manifest schema. Suggest: {"version": "1", "tenant_id": "T123", "interval_start": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z", "sha256_root": "...", "signed_by": "key-id"}. Keep small and easy to verify.
Samir Patel: Quick API sketch for on-demand snapshot:
```
POST /v1/tenants/T123/snapshots?hold=true
Body: { "reason": "litigation", "requester": "security@customer.com" }
Response: { "snapshot_id": "s-01", "manifest_url": "https://...", "signed": true }
```
Maya Lin: UX: retention controls in Console -> Tenant settings. Add tooltip: "Legal hold preserves snapshots regardless of retention TTL". Need copy from legal.
Jordan (Security): Compliance gating checklist (must before customer-facing):
- Keystore audit logs enabled + retention
- Onboarding handshake logged + mTLS to KMS providers
- Signed manifest verification docs + test vectors
- Pen test of snapshot export flow
If any item fails, default to disable exports for that tenant.
Amit Rao: Dependencies: eng-infra for KMS adapters, eng-runtime for manifest signing pipeline, devex for SDK patch, legal for copy & acceptable retention definitions.
Chris Park: Est estimate: KMS adapter + handshake 3 dev-weeks, manifest pipeline 2 dev-weeks, Console + SDK changes 1.5 weeks, testing + docs 1 week. Parallelize where possible.
Samir Patel: Customer asks: FinRegCorp wants 7-year retention for specific logs. We should support per-tenant overrides but warn on cost.
Maya Lin: Acceptance criteria (MVP launch):
- Customers can onboard BYOK (wrap OR KMS ARN) and verify status in Console
- Tenant retention buckets configurable and enforced by pipeline
- Weekly signed manifest available for last 90 days + on-demand signed snapshots
- Export API returns signed manifest and checksum
- Playbook for legal hold + runbook for support
ops-bot: created issue #4821: "log-provenance: manifest pipeline and BYOK onboarding" assigned to @chris.
Jordan (Security): One more: add a verification helper in docs with a sample public key and verification command (openssl / jq). That'll speed audits.
Amit Rao: Action items:
- Chris: draft manifest schema + PR for runtime (due Wed)
- Maya: Console mockups for tenant retention + legal hold (due Thu)
- Samir: scope KMS providers to support for MVP (AWS/GCP) and note edge cases (HSM-only customers) (due Thu)
- Jordan: compliance gating checklist + test vectors (due Fri)
We'll reconvene Friday 11am to lock MVP. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
